notes.title: Update 1.4.0 - Difficulty Swapping!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40539370/d82ad23fa476377ad98e4f43abb00cd901530a4b.png[/img]

The big feature of this update is difficulty swapping! If you begin a file in "retro" mode, you may now switch to "newcomer" mode at any point. Please note that this conversion is [i]one way[/i]. There is no bumping up the difficulty from an easier file!

[h3]Misc.[/h3]
[list]
[*] You may now swap the difficulty to "newcomer" from a "retro" file. This can be done from the "file select" screen.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the boomerang sound effect would play for far too long.
[*] Fixed a soft lock in Act 2 where the player could leave behind the Bellion, locking themselves in a pit.
[*] Fixed a bug in Act 3 where Belle and all of the enemies would disappear.
[*] Fixed a couple of background inconsistencies corresponding to Act 3.
[*] Fixed a soft lock in Act 4 where the player could defeat the boss prematurely.
[/list]
I apologize that this update came so soon after 1.3.2. Thank you once again to all of the new players! Feel free to reach out with any further bug reports and suggestions.

notes.title: Update 1.3.1 - Watercolor Falls
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40539370/e9d511ab2a8b1bfb9b228aad9c82a662400fb243.png[/img]

The big feature of this update is the overhauled background of Act 3. This update also addresses concerns of motion sickness, fixes a few bugs, and overall ties the game closer to its upcoming Nintendo Switch counterpart.

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] The intro now features a “photosensitivity warning”.
[*] Act 3 has received a significant amount of polish. The new backgrounds allow the viewer’s eyes more space to rest and are more compositionally interesting.
[*] The Intermission and all other instances of Act 3 background elements have received similar polish.
[/list]
[h3]Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players must now press the Up Button to interact with NPCs.
[*] In textboxes, the star icon has been changed to an A Button icon. This change can only be seen when using a gamepad.
[*] Plugging in a new gamepad will now register during active gameplay.
[/list]
[h3]Misc.[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Bellion’s attack will no longer staircase upwards when jumping.
[*] The Hshu Hshu enemies now burst quicker when hitting a wall or a screen boundary.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Bellion would shift forward upon being possessed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Bellion would be unable to pick up bells with ribbons.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Zoontites would flip back and forth rapidly.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Sheris would begin moving forward in air.
[*] Fixed a discolored screen transition in Act 8, Scene 4.
[*] Fixed a bug where stars would spawn twice in Act 8.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Hshu Hshu’s head would detach.
[*] Fixed a visual error where you could see the edge of an offscreen sprite in Act 12, Scene 2.
[/list]
Please let me know if you find any further bugs! Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Third Face
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40539370/ba5acb2bfe4c02b5d8eb383f42eee963c7c05983.png[/img]

This update overhauls the controls for PC players and the soon to come Nintendo Switch players. The most notable change is the addition of a "third face".

[h3]Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the option of "3 faces". This allocates the functions of some powerups to an additional face button (C/magic).
[*] The statue powerup can now be activated with C/magic or B/toss, if "3 faces" is toggled ON.
[*] The freeze powerup is now activated by C/magic, if "3 faces" is toggled ON.
[*] The static powerup is now activated by C/magic, if "3 faces" is toggled ON.
[*] When "3 faces" is toggled OFF, the static powerup is now deactivated by A/jump.
[*] The rose powerup can now be activated with C/magic or down, if "3 faces" is toggled ON.
[*] The controls menu now uses a controller diagram, showing the ideal location of the inputs being mapped.
[*] The controls menu now uses a model Belle avatar, showing the function of the inputs being mapped when applicable.
[*] Weapon descriptions (seen on the pause menu) have been slightly changed to match the terminology used on the controls menu.
[*] To match the pause menu, the weapon icons on the bottom-right of the screen now use button symbols (A, B, and C), if a gamepad is plugged in.
[/list]
[h3]Misc.[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game can now be paused while Belle is controlling a statue or inside of an electric current.
[*] Fixed a bug  where a puff of smoke would appear when exiting the statistics room in the Backstage.
[*] Slightly adjusted the placements of some tiles in Act 8.
[/list]
Please notify me if you have any troubles with your gamepad of choice! Thank you!

notes.title: Gameplay Balancing Update 1.1.0 is Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40539370/20de0c5b5e197f75aabf1c271e39ab13f7c28cd1.png[/img]

There are quite a few changes this time around. Most are behind the scenes, but there should be a noticeable difference in the difficulty for some players.

The goal is not to make the whole game easier, but to smooth the difficulty curve just a bit.

[b]Act 3[/b]
[list]
[*] Foamflowers can now only produce 1 enemy at a time. [i](This change can also be seen in Act 9.)[/i]
[/list]
[b]Act 5[/b]
[list]
[*] A checkpoint has been moved from Scene 6 to Scene 5.
[*] An additional checkpoint has been added in Scene 7.
[*] The placement of some geysers, platforms, and bells have been moved for clarity.
[*] Geysers and raindrops now melt at a decreased rate when interacted with. [i](This change can also be seen in Acts 7 and 11.)[/i]
[/list]
[b]Misc.[/b]
[list]
[*] The snowflake/freezing animation is now quicker to better match hitbox durations.
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred in some enemy types when falling off a ledge.
[*] Fixed a bug where ice shards lingered during a screen transition.
[/list]
Please let me know if any additional bugs pop up and be sure to stay tuned. [i]More exciting news is on the way![/i]

Thank you to everyone for the continued support!
